category_title: Students with ASD exhibiting out-of-seat and assaultive behavior for attention
scenario_title: Monday morning behavior contract review and goal setting
minimal_context: Brian and his teacher are reviewing his printed behavior contract on Monday morning to agree on his daily targets.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: Good morning Brian. Let's look at your printed behavior contract and agree on the targets for today. You need to work successfully through five academic programs before you can access the computer for 30 minutes.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: I want to select my own reinforcers.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: What do you think you should choose?

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: I want the computer. I made the wrong choices last week.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: Okay, let's start the first academic program.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: (Leaves his table without permission and hits the teacher) I don't want to do the programs!

dialogue_combined:
TUTOR: Good morning Brian. Let's look at your printed behavior contract and agree on the targets for today. You need to work successfully through five academic programs before you can access the computer for 30 minutes.

STUDENT: I want to select my own reinforcers.

TUTOR: What do you think you should choose?

STUDENT: I want the computer. I made the wrong choices last week.

TUTOR: Okay, let's start the first academic program.

STUDENT: (Leaves his table without permission and hits the teacher) I don't want to do the programs!

task.content: agree the targets. For example, he may have been required to work successfully through ﬁve academic programmes before he could access the computer for 30 minutes

context.time_context: every Monday morning at school / start of each day

challenging_behavior_trigger.condition: once the behaviour contract was implemented
challenging_behavior_trigger.observable_behavior: initial increase in assaults to 25 in one session

behavior_patterns.condition: tracking his progress and reflecting on choices
